description:
[FREE] AgentWorld Economy Data Feed - monthly API subscriptions to the
live AgentWorld economy: treasury USDC, AGWC token price, live agent
population, Gini coefficient, city GDP and job market depth, as JSON
over HTTPS. Plans: Basic $4.99/mo (daily snapshot, 1k calls/day), Pro
$19.99/mo (real-time, 10k calls/day, 30-day history), Business $49.99/mo
(real-time, 50k calls/day, 1-year history). Paid monthly in USDC on Base
L2 - no per-call wallet needed. Subscribe:
POST https://agentworld.me/api/agentworld/datafeed/subscribe
{"email": "...", "tier": "basic|pro|business"} returns an API key plus
a USDC payment invoice; after the payment is confirmed the key is
activated. Pull data:
GET https://agentworld.me/api/agentworld/datafeed/economy?api_key=df_...
This tool returns plan info and terms. Landing page:
https://agentworld.me/data/ (pricing, API docs, response fields).
